title: SUPER DESKTOP plugin registry (registry.json), registryVersion 2
description: The public list of SUPER DESKTOP plugins (QML plugins with a plugin.json). Each entry points at the plugin's own git repository, which `super-desktop plugin install https://github.com/<repo>` installs. Listing is not a review: an installed plugin runs only after the user approves it.

id.description: The id in the plugin's plugin.json (also its folder name once installed).

name.description: The name in the plugin's plugin.json.

description.description: One or two sentences of what the user gets.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name of the plugin's repository; plugin.json is at its top level.

api.description: The plugin API version its plugin.json declares ("api").

minHost.description: The lowest SUPER DESKTOP version that has everything the plugin uses.

slots.description: Where its surfaces go, from its plugin.json (sorted, no repeats).
